doc.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Father's records: Ellington, Basie, Billie Holiday and Charlie Shavers
summary: His father played jazz on the Victrola from the time Owens was three or four.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: When you were a child, did you hear jazz in the house?

Oh yes, my father played jazz all the time on the record player, Victrola. When I was three or four years old, I had my favorite records that I could go and pick out the record and put it on the Victrola and play it. The music that my father played most of the time were people like Duke Ellington, Billie Holliday, Count Basie’s band, Charlie Shavers, this is what I was hearing when I was a kid.
